quest.title: On This Intoxicating Night
quest.description: The Knights of Favonius's expeditionary force seems to be anticipating something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x4

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: One more plate... Okay, this is the last one! Paimon swears!

talks.objective: Talk to Varka at the Favonius Keep

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: ...Nannina's covering the north, so we'll have Laurent take the east... Right, that's all for now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heya, Varka!

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Huh? Honorary Knight? Paimon? What brings you to my camp?

choices.text: Just moseying about, happened to run into you...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Not at all! Any camp of the Knights of Favonius is your camp too, so make yourself at home.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Though you should give me a heads up next time so I can have the quartermaster break out the good stuff for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is this really the expeditionary force's camp? Paimon was expecting it to be a bit more... crowded?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Not many from the force are still stationed here, and of those who are, most are out patrolling. Truth be told... Hahaha, it is a bit of a ghost town.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What are the people left here doing?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Gathering all the Abyss-related intel we can. Naturally, we're focusing on dealing with the Wild Hunt right now.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: To that end, we're collecting intel from across Nod-Krai. Even with Rerir sealed, things haven't completely quieted down yet.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: We're also gathering all the Abyss-related intel we can. Situation in Nod-Krai's stable for now, but we must remain vigilant. You never know when the Abyss'll come roaring back.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Intelligence is the foundation of any campaign. It's not just enemy movements — terrain or shifts in the weather can mean the difference between victory and defeat.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Moving forward, we plan to form a long-term partnership with the Northern Intelligence Network, turn this temporary camp into an intelligence station.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A—An intelligence station? Whoa, like the kind in Fontainian spy thrillers!?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Haha, as if! Name one book with a camp this lightly defended in it!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: During these years out on campaign, we've found that different Abyssal disasters are occurring all over Teyvat. They're unnaturally cunning, always shifting, with no two attacks quite going off the same.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: I hope to use the Northern Intelligence Network to share our findings, and use that collaboration to keep gathering information on the Abyss.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: This isn't any one nation's burden. Every day, countless winds blow through Nod-Krai... I'd say that makes it the perfect place to set up an outpost.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohhh, so that's why... So this is "chivalry" in action!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Haha! Well, "chivalry"'s good and all, but in reality... We've only just established this station, and don't even have a good map of the nearby terrain.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: If you stumble across any building materials or intel nearby, don't forget to bring them back with you.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Rest assured, you're our Honorary Knight. We'll look after you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Leave it to me!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Ha, one expedition wraps up, another begins.

response.speaker: Winfried
response.text: G—Grand Master! We've got big trouble, Sir!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Oh? What is it?

response.speaker: Winfried
response.text: That important guest we were expecting today... He's trapped at the foot of the mountain!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: WHAT!? Is it... who I think it is!?

response.speaker: Winfried
response.text: Yes, Sir! It's him! Most of our available manpower is tied up in patrols. Who do we reassign...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: —No need! Just point me in the right direction, I'll handle it myself! Honorary Knight, Paimon, 'til next time!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Varka storms out like the very wind...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Whoa, Paimon's never seen Varka so nervous! Now she's curious who that guest is...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Could it be... a critical informant?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that's probably it! Let's follow him and see if he needs help!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: —Hey, are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Donatas
dialogues.text: I—I'm fine... Phew, good thing you guys showed up so fast, or I might not have made it by sundown.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: ...Praise be! Our "essential supplies" made it through, safe and sound.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, what kind of supplies are that important...?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Good eye! This here is the Dandelion Wine we specially ordered from Dawn Winery! Pure Mondstadt in a bottle!

response.speaker: Donatas
response.text: You have no idea what it took us to get it here all the way from there.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Hah, and a fine job you did! You're drinking with us at the feast tonight. Whole camp's been looking forward to toasting you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...So the only reason you were in a hurry was to make sure the drinks got there in time? And here Paimon thought you were finally being serious about something serious...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: What's that? Are you saying drinking isn't the most serious of serious business? Because I'd love to have a drink right about... now.

response.speaker: Donatas
response.text: W—Wait! Please, wait a second! Now's not a good time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, listen to him! First, you gotta take care of the serious...

response.speaker: Donatas
response.text: This is a custom brew, it needs to be kept constantly rolling to prevent settling and keep its flavor! Having sat for so long, I'd say the taste has degraded... by at least ten percent!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Ten percent!? Unacceptable! Nobody touches a drop 'til it's ready!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Ooookay. You do you, then.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, how can we bring it back up to scratch?

response.speaker: Donatas
response.text: We specially commissioned someone to build a mechanism that keeps the barrels rolling... Looks like it broke in the fall, though. So now, I guess we'll have to rely on old-fashioned muscle power.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Hmm, so we just <color=#00E1FFFF>keep whacking the wooden barrels and roll 'em to their destination</color>...? Sounds like some good old Knights of Favonius strength training.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wait, the Knights train that way?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Aye, teaches force control and precision. Need both, or the barrel won't stay true to the path. It's basic training for many knights.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Hah, keen on basic drills, are we? Well, Laurent and the others won't be back for a while...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Right then, all yours. Don't worry about knocking 'em a bit too far. Just holler and I'll toss 'em back into place.

choices.text: As the Honorary Knight, I'd like to try my hand.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Need me on barrel duty, or just wanted to chat for a bit?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Right then! No quitting now, chin up and try again!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Back when I was training Noelle, she'd blast the barrels to splinters the second she got nervous. Couldn't stop her from cleaning up the whole mess herself afterward.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Over time... She became the finest cleaner in the Knights, bar none. Ha, she might not have realized it, but that's progress too.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Need me on barrel duty, or just wanted to chat for a bit?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Right then! No quitting now, chin up and try again!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: First time I did this training with Razor, it took us an entire day to finish. Know why?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: —He spent a quarter of the day rolling the barrels, and the other three quarters trying to figure out what the heck I was talking about.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Need me on barrel duty, or just wanted to chat for a bit?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Right then! No quitting now, chin up and try again!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Jean and Albedo once sat me down to have a serious discussion about whether or not the Spark Knight needed to take part in basic training like this.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: A knight's basic training helps build character, but since the Spark Knight's still so young... I decided to get her opinion.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...She happily brought her bombs to the training grounds. And so, we reached a consensus: We won't discuss the matter again until she's a bit older.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Need me on barrel duty, or just wanted to chat for a bit?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Right then! No quitting now, chin up and try again!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Come to think of it, you haven't met Lohen yet, have you? Kid's so used to doing things his way, he didn't even show up when it was time for the training.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Asked him about it later, he said he went to poke a hornet's nest full of monsters, and as for barrel drills... He didn't think targets that wouldn't hit back were worth his time.

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: Ah! Grand Master! Honorary Knight! They're back!

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: They're back! They're back! Everyone, fall in and give 'em a proper welcome!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, we're this popular? Paimon feels like blushing...

dialogues.speaker: Leifhelm
dialogues.text: —How the wind carries that scent from afar! Sweet Barbatos, it's true! Dandelion Wine!

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: A special brew from Dawn Winery, to boot! They're back... all my precious memories... they're all flooding back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... So, the welcome isn't for us, is it...

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: Yes, this is it, this is the taste... It's just how I remembered it!

dialogues.speaker: Leifhelm
dialogues.text: Amazing, after all these years...

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: Ah, I was starting to think I'd already forgotten the taste of a good Dawn Winery vintage...

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: If the taste hasn't changed... then my home back in Springvale probably hasn't changed either... right?

response.speaker: Ekbert
response.text: ...Thank you, Honorary Knight!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...That's enough, put a cork in it, everyone. Barrels stay sealed until everyone's back. Let's finish the party prep in the meantime.

response.speaker: Winfried
response.text: Yes, Sir! On it, Sir!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...Like I said: Drinking is the most serious of serious business.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooooh... Sticky Honey Roast... Sweet Madames... Paimon never thought she'd get to eat such authentic Mondstadt dishes out here...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, wait, where's Varka? Anyone seen him? He's not passed out drunk in a ditch somewhere, is he?

choices.text: Given his liver's battle prowess, is that even possible?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay... Paimon'll catch up once she finishes!

choices.text: I'll go find him, you keep eating.
It's the same, I've been there.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: So, what's the hero who saved our savior and brought it back to camp doing in a corner like this?

choices.text: Took the words right out of my mouth.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Heh... Truth is, what I've got in my cup is the most special of special brews. It can only be drunk alone...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...But since you've caught me, nothing for it. Here, have a cup.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Got me! Just a joke. Not a drop of liquor on me right now. If you're thirsty for a real drink, go find Erminie later, she's got plenty in stock.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: A camp always needs to have one sober soul to guard their drunk comrades from things that go bump in the night. Those have been my standing orders since this expedition started.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Rotten luck, eh? Just so happens that tonight, it's my turn to be that sober soul.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...So, on this night when they're all drunk, I can't be.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Who knows? Maybe fate just gets a kick out of messing with us? If it'd come one day later, maybe I'd have been down there guzzling wine to my heart's content.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: But if it had come but one day later, maybe you'd have passed the camp by. Missed the feast. Never even had this chance to talk.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Nobody can say what choices lead to what outcomes until the time comes.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Just like when I decided to lead this expedition out of Mondstadt... never imagined I'd make it this far.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The reason you launched the expedition... was it to deal with the Wild Hunt?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...That's how it turned out, aye. But when we marched, all I "knew" was this: An Abyssal storm was brewing up north, one that threatened to scour all of Teyvat.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: It took us some time to mobilize, but where would the enemy appear, and what form would they take?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...That was all a complete mystery to us when we set out. All we could do was gather intel as we marched, preparing for every contingency.

choices.text: That's all you knew, and you still launched the expedition?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Ha! Quick study, aren't you? Alas, the enemy won't sit around twiddling their thumbs while we finish preparing.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Every hour we hesitated, the Abyss was devouring the lives of countless people. The sooner we marched, the sooner we could change their fates.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: —That was all the intel we needed to launch this "expedition."

choices.text: No wonder you're the Knight of Boreas...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: None of that formality, "Honorary Knight"! And you're no different. Your journey's also changed many people's fates.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Be it Mondstadt back then, Dvalin... or Nod-Krai now, the expeditionary force... even my fate, too.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: #The fact that we can sing around the bonfire, drinking and thinking about the future... None of that could've happened without your arrival, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Am I really that amazing?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...Hah, who's to say? Fate's fickle and hard to fathom, after all. But as long as you're alive, there's hope.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: The wine we didn't drink tonight, we can have tomorrow — the lads'll save my share. As long as we're still breathing, tomorrow'll bring more wine and laughter!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: So, cheers! To tomorrow! To hope!

choices.text: That's the Knights of Favonius for you...
Didn't you say intelligence is the foundation of any campaign?
On the very day the Dandelion Wine was due to arrive?

dialogues.speaker: Critical Informant?
dialogues.text: H—Help, please help me!
